AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.

   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Integrated Farming.

5. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening 14 2.2 Storage of Crop Produce 10 2.3 Cooking: Using Flour Mix.

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr? (1 mark)

   B. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.

14. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Leftover Food? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Leftover Food.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Leftover Food.

16. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
